name: Blockstream Satellite
what_it_is: A Python CLI and GUI toolkit for receiving the Blockstream Satellite signal that broadcasts the Bitcoin blockchain worldwide over DVB-S2 satellite. It handles receiver configuration, signal acquisition, dependency installation, API message transmission (paid via Lightning Network), and Bitcoin node integration across four receiver types.
components: blocksatcli Python package (core logic: config, sdr, usb, standalone, satip, api, bitcoin, monitoring)
Docker image blockstream/satellite (Ubuntu Jammy base, includes CLI, GUI, Bitcoin Satellite, SDR/USB/Sat-IP deps)
Bitcoin Satellite application (bitcoinsatellite fork for satellite-sourced blockchain sync)
Satellite API server (https://api.blockstream.space, testnet variant available)
protocols: Lightning Network (payment for API message transmission bids)
HTTPS REST (Satellite API orders, monitoring reporting)
GPG/OpenPGP (message encryption and signing for API transmissions)
FEC (forward error correction applied to API messages)
SSE (Server-Sent Events for API channel streaming: transmissions, auth, gossip, btc-src)
measurement: Metrics reportable to remote monitoring server (Blockstream monitoring API or custom TLS-authenticated endpoint)
configuration: Interactive CLI wizard: satellite selection, receiver type, antenna size, LNB model
Config stored in ~/.blocksat/ (JSON, supports named config sets via --cfg flag)
Supported satellites: Galaxy 18 (G18), Telstar 11N Africa, Telstar 11N Europe, Telstar 18V C-Band, Telstar 18V Ku-Band
Supported receiver types: Linux USB (TBS 5927, TBS 5520SE), Software-Defined Radio (RTL-SDR), Standalone (Novra S400), Sat-IP (Selfsat IP22 / Blockstream Base Station)
LNB options: Ku-band universal (9750/10600 MHz LO) and C-band (5150 MHz LO) models
API channel selection: USER (paid), AUTH, GOSSIP (Lightning gossip snapshots), BTC_SRC (Bitcoin source code)
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection framework found in the codebase
DemoRx class (blocksatcli/api/demorx.py) provides a demo receiver for testing API listen without real hardware
Testnet API server (https://api.blockstream.space/testnet) available for API order testing without real payments
modes: SDR mode: RTL-SDR dongle + leandvb software demodulator pipeline
Linux USB mode: TBS DVB-S2 USB receiver with kernel drivers
Standalone mode: Novra S400 professional IRD (managed over IP)
Sat-IP mode: Selfsat IP22 integrated flat-panel antenna with IP output
Hybrid connectivity: simultaneous internet + satellite Bitcoin node
Satellite-only connectivity: full blockchain sync without internet
Docker mode: all receiver types supported inside blockstream/satellite container (--network=host required)
constraints: Linux-only for hardware receiver commands (usb, standalone, sdr, sat-ip, firewall, rp, gqrx subcommands); macOS/Windows only supported for cfg, instructions, api, btc subcommands
Docker container requires --network=host and privileged/device access for USB and SDR receivers
RTL-SDR requires fs.pipe-max-size kernel tuning (sysctl) for sufficient pipe buffer
USB receivers require out-of-tree TBS kernel drivers (installed via blocksat-cli deps install --target usb)
API message transmission requires Lightning Network payment (bid in millisatoshis); only USER channel is paid
GPG keyring must be configured before sending encrypted API messages
C-band satellites (Telstar 18V C) incompatible with flat-panel and Sat-IP antenna types
BLOCKSAT_NO_USB_DRIVERS_CHECK=true env var disables USB driver check in Docker (set by default in image)
docker_services: blockstream/satellite (single container: CLI + GUI + Bitcoin Satellite + all receiver dependencies, Ubuntu Jammy base, tagged by blocksat-cli version)
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml — only a single standalone Dockerfile (docker/blocksat-host.docker)
No simulation or emulated satellite signal source for end-to-end offline testing
No Windows native support for any receiver hardware commands
No built-in fault injection or chaos testing tooling
